title: Vinogradov Conjecture on the Least Quadratic Non-Residue
exact_target: Is the least quadratic nonresidue modulo a prime smaller, up to a constant, than every fixed positive power of that prime?

sources.citation: E. Carneiro, M. B. Milinovich, E. Quesada-Herrera and A. P. Ramos, "Fourier optimization, the least quadratic non-residue, and the least prime in an arithmetic progression", arXiv:2404.08380 [math.NT], version dated 13 August 2025.
